name: FUNSD
description: A dataset of 199 noisy scanned forms with annotations for text detection, OCR, spatial layout analysis, and entity labeling and linking.
citation: Guillaume Jaume, Hazim Kemal Ekenel, and Jean-Philippe Thiran. FUNSD: A Dataset for Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents. ICDAR 2019 OST Workshop. https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.13538

license.notes: Dataset license is unverified; no published dataset license was confirmed.
